page.title: Hand coffee grinder
page.lede: A wooden box mill drawn as twelve solids in a CAD kernel. Explode it, play the assembly, click a part: mass is the exact volume times the density, and the cost by batch follows from assumptions that are shown, not hidden.
examples: await grinderExample({ ...env, camera, controls, renderer, report: GRINDER_REPORT, bom: { ASSUMPTIONS, bom }, parts: await loadParts(GLB.grinder) })
